name: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS)
definition: A method to optimize a parameterized scene (e.g., NeRF) using a frozen 2D diffusion model as a loss function, avoiding backpropagation through the diffusion model itself.
summary: Score Distillation Sampling optimizes 3D scene representations using a frozen 2D diffusion model's score function, avoiding unstable backpropagation through the model itself.
